extracted.name: Vegetable Zucchini Soup
extracted.description: Need to use up what I had on hand so I made this soup. It turned out really good 😊
ingredient_lines: 1 Lg. Can Whole Kernel Corn, drained
1 Lg. Can Diced Tomatoes w/ Green Chiles
instruction_lines: In a Large Stock pot add everything together and bring to a boil on high heat. Once to a boil lower heat to a simmer and let soup simmer covered til potatoes and zucchini is tender; stirring ever so often. Once vegetables are soft turn off heat and Serve with Crusty Buttered Bread.
**If need to u can Adjust the seasonings to your liking by adding more or less 😊. And make sure there’s enough broth to completely cover the vegetables to cook them and extra for the soup.
